message.content: Logistic regression is a statistical technique used for predicting a binary outcome (e.g., yes/no, success/failure) based on one or more predictor variables. It models the log‑odds of the outcome as a linear combination of the predictors and uses the logistic (sigmoid) function to convert those log‑odds into probabilities between 0 and 1.
